why: The file tickets (wave 13s, line 13s, SEC-2): a ticket asked without both halves of a paired browser's key, and a load whose ticket this office does not honour. No request in this test carries a half of a device key, asks a ticket or loads a file by one. tests/a-file-ticket.test.ts meets both through their doors: fileTicketNeedsTwoHalves in case 8, and fileTicketNotHonoured in cases 2 to 6.
